### The Model Judge
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/model-judge
Passage: Judges 3:9
Points:
- God permitted enemy nations to test Israel's loyalty and train future generations in battle.
- When Israel turned to idolatry and suffered under harsh oppression, the Lord heard their repentant cries.
- God answered by raising up Caleb's nephew Othniel as Israel's first and model judge.
- Unlike later judges who pursued personal acclaim, Othniel served humbly and sought only God's glory.
- Believers are reminded that all spiritual fruit and steadfast obedience depend entirely on the Holy Spirit.
